"""Finite test-only wrong implementations; no product file is modified."""
import ast
from copy import deepcopy
import inspect
import os

import pytest


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def inject_locked_decision_control(monkeypatch):
    mode = os.environ['LOCKED_DECISION_CONTROL']
    if mode == 'baseline':
        return
    from sprintctl import db, pg
    backend = db if mode == 'sqlite-early-read' else pg
    tree = ast.parse(inspect.getsource(backend._decide_locked))
    function = tree.body[0]
    changed = 0
    if mode == 'sqlite-early-read':
        assert isinstance(function.body[-1], ast.Return)
        original_return = deepcopy(function.body[-1].value)
        index = next(i for i, n in enumerate(function.body)
                     if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == 'decision_id' for t in n.targets))
        function.body.insert(index+1, ast.Assign(targets=[ast.Name(id='_early_recorded', ctx=ast.Store())], value=original_return))
        function.body[-1].value = ast.Name(id='_early_recorded', ctx=ast.Load())
        changed = 1
    elif mode == 'pg-copy-result':
        assert isinstance(function.body[-1], ast.Return)
        function.body[-1].value = ast.Call(func=ast.Name(id='dict', ctx=ast.Load()),
                                         args=[function.body[-1].value], keywords=[])
        changed = 1
    elif mode == 'pg-late-decode':
        assignment = next(n for n in function.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign)
                          and isinstance(n.value, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.value.func, ast.Name)
                          and n.value.func.id == '_decision_row')
        assignment.value = assignment.value.args[0]  # Actual RETURNING row, decoder deferred.
        function.body.insert(len(function.body)-1, ast.Assign(targets=[ast.Name(id='recorded', ctx=ast.Store())],
            value=ast.Call(func=ast.Name(id='_decision_row', ctx=ast.Load()),
                           args=[ast.Name(id='recorded', ctx=ast.Load())], keywords=[])))
        changed = 1
    else:
        class Transform(ast.NodeTransformer):
            def visit_Expr(self, node):
                nonlocal changed
                call = node.value
                stamp = isinstance(call, ast.Call) and isinstance(call.func, ast.Name) and call.func.id == '_stamp_awaiting_reports'
                lease = (isinstance(call, ast.Call) and isinstance(call.func, ast.Attribute) and call.func.attr == 'execute'
                         and call.args and isinstance(call.args[0], ast.Constant) and isinstance(call.args[0].value, str)
                         and call.args[0].value.startswith('UPDATE work_lease '))
                if (stamp and mode in ('pg-omit-stamp', 'pg-duplicate-stamp')) or (
                        lease and mode in ('pg-omit-lease', 'pg-duplicate-lease')):
                    changed += 1
                    return None if '-omit-' in mode else [node, deepcopy(node)]
                return self.generic_visit(node)
        tree = Transform().visit(tree)
    assert changed == 1, (mode, changed)
    namespace = {}
    exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(tree), '<locked-decision-oracle-control>', 'exec'), backend.__dict__, namespace)
    monkeypatch.setattr(backend, '_decide_locked', namespace['_decide_locked'])

"""Test-only successor reread mutant; never changes product files."""
import ast
import inspect
import os
import pytest

@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def inject(monkeypatch):
    mode = os.environ.get('SUCCESSOR_CONTROL', 'baseline')
    if mode == 'baseline':
        return
    from sprintctl import db, pg
    backend = db if mode == 'sqlite-reread' else pg
    tree = ast.parse(inspect.getsource(backend._decide_locked))
    count = 0
    class Reread(ast.NodeTransformer):
        def visit_Call(self, node):
            nonlocal count
            if (isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute) and node.func.attr == 'execute'
                and node.args and isinstance(node.args[0], ast.Constant)
                and 'INSERT INTO work_decision' in node.args[0].value):
                args = node.args[1]
                assert isinstance(args, ast.Tuple)
                assert isinstance(args.elts[-1], ast.Name) and args.elts[-1].id == 'superseded_by'
                args.elts[-1] = ast.parse("decision['superseded_by_item_id']", mode='eval').body
                count += 1
            return self.generic_visit(node)
    tree = Reread().visit(tree)
    assert count == 1
    namespace = {}
    exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(tree), '<successor-reread-control>', 'exec'), backend.__dict__, namespace)
    monkeypatch.setattr(backend, '_decide_locked', namespace['_decide_locked'])
